_meta.source: Unbound Knowledge Crafting and Profession Systems document.
notes: Profession Skills use the same XP pool as combat skills.
level cost: R+1 XP to raise from R to R+1. (R1=1, R2=2, R3=3, R4=4, R5=5 = 15 XP total to max.)
Skill level may never exceed the governing stat level.
Recipe memory: level squared (crafting recipes). level cubed (tool recipes).
Missing tags can be bridged by skill level: R1=10%, R2=20%, R3=30%, R4=40%, R5=50% of recipe tags.
Affinity Styles function as Profession Skills for spell formula work.
Knowledge Tags are earned through play — not purchased with XP.
Tag tiers: T1=common, T2=uncommon, T3=rare, T4=epic, T5=world-unique.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Craft common metal items. Use basic toolkits. Identify quality and materials. Salvage basic components.

2.title: Skilled
2.capabilities: Craft uncommon items. Reduce mundane craft time by 50%. Repair damaged items. Apply 1 Modular Upgrade.

3.title: Professional
3.capabilities: Craft rare items. Combine two material types. Apply 2 Modular Upgrades. Reduce material cost by 25%.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Multi-profession crafting (secondary at level 2+). Apply 3 Modular Upgrades. Create Custom Templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Craft epic items (legendary if assisted). Field-ready crafting without workshop. Instill signature traits. Reduce DC by 2 for all related checks.

4.capabilities: Multi-profession crafting. Custom Templates. 1 reroll per project.

enchanting.name: Enchanting
enchanting.description: Adds magical properties to base items. Requires a base item.
enchanting.special_rules: Requires base item. Enchantment quality is capped by the base item tier and the crafter's level.

1.capabilities: Apply minor enchantments to common items. Identify existing enchantments.

2.title: Skilled
2.capabilities: Apply uncommon enchantments. Repair faded enchantments. Stack 1 effect.

3.title: Professional
3.capabilities: Apply rare enchantments. Combine two effect types. Reduce material cost by 25%.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Apply epic enchantments. Custom enchantment templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Apply legendary enchantments. Instill unique properties. DC -2.

weapon_crafter_style.name: Weapon Crafter Style
weapon_crafter_style.notes: Bonus scales with associated Profession Skill level, not Style level alone.

1.name: Weapon Intuition
1.effect: +level to attack rolls with weapons in associated profession categories.

2.name: Stress Reading
2.effect: Once per round, identify a structural weakness. Next attack against that target deals +Profession level bonus damage.

3.name: Edge Knowledge
3.effect: Critical hit range expands by 1 with self-category weapons. Critical success triggers the weapon's crafted critical bonus if applicable.

4.name: Breaking Point
4.effect: Strike targeting a held item or armor piece. Inflict Structural Flaw on a failed BDY save.

5.name: Master's Touch
5.effect: While wielding a weapon in associated category, gain +Profession level to all attack and damage rolls. Field repair any weapon in associated category as a 2 AP action.

armor_crafter_style.name: Armor Crafter Style
armor_crafter_style.notes: Bonus scales with associated Profession Skill level.

1.name: Construction Awareness
1.effect: +level to Defense rolls while wearing armor in associated profession categories.

2.name: Load Management
2.effect: Reduce AP penalty from armor weight by Profession level.

3.name: Stress Distribution
3.effect: When armor takes a critical hit, reduce damage by Profession level. May trigger once per round.

4.name: Field Repair
4.effect: Restore Profession level HP to worn armor between or during combat. Requires basic tools.

5.name: Second Skin
5.effect: Armor in associated category no longer imposes movement penalties. Gain +Profession level to all Defense rolls while wearing associated armor.

consumable_crafter_style.name: Consumable Crafter Style
consumable_crafter_style.notes: Bonus scales with associated Profession Skill level.

1.name: Precise Application
1.effect: Potions and oils in associated category restore or deal +Profession level bonus effect value.

2.name: Efficient Dosing
2.effect: Reduce AP cost of applying consumables in associated category by 1 (minimum 1).

3.name: Optimized Timing
3.effect: May delay a consumable effect by up to level rounds. Triggering the delay costs 0 AP.

4.name: Compound Effect
4.effect: When applying two consumables in the same round, the second costs 0 AP. Both effects apply.

5.name: Master Formulator
5.effect: Consumables in associated category last +Profession level rounds, or have their effect multiplied by 1.5. Choose per item at time of use.

projectile_crafter_style.name: Projectile Crafter Style
projectile_crafter_style.notes: Bonus scales with associated Profession Skill level.

1.name: Trajectory Knowledge
1.effect: +level to ranged attack rolls with projectile weapons in associated categories.

2.name: Material Optimization
2.effect: Ammunition in associated categories gains +Profession level to penetration (reduces target armor DR).

3.name: Precision Construction
3.effect: Once per round, designate a shot as a Precision Strike. Deal Profession level bonus damage and ignore cover bonuses.

4.name: Custom Load
4.effect: Apply a prepared material coating to ammunition (fire, acid, paralytic, etc.) without breaking action economy.

5.name: Master Fletcher
5.effect: Ranged attacks with associated category weapons may apply the weapon's crafted critical bonus on any hit that exceeds target Defense by Profession level or more.

knowledge_tag_system.description: Knowledge Tags represent working understanding of materials, techniques, and processes. Earned through play. Never purchased with XP.

material.description: Working knowledge of a substance — what it is, how it behaves, how it responds to tools, heat, alchemical processes, or magical forces.

technique.description: Working knowledge of a process or method — how to shape, combine, or encode something.

formula.description: Working knowledge of a specific magical structure or spell logic. Applies to Affinity Style practitioners writing or analyzing spell formulas.

T1.name: Common
T1.access: Village trainers, common gathering, basic recipes

T3.name: Rare
T3.access: Specialist trainers (Rapport required), rare materials, dungeon content

T4.name: Epic
T4.access: Grandmaster access or unique discovery only

T5.name: Legendary
T5.access: World-unique. Found in isolated cultures, lost ruins, boss-tier content

how_gained: Completing a recipe or formula that contains tags not yet possessed — craft must fully succeed.
Profession Trainer instruction with working demonstration — requires materials, coin, and completion of demonstration craft.
Gathering and examining new materials — sufficient engagement may resolve into T1 tag.
Deconstruction of found items — extracts Pattern and associated tags if knowledge threshold is met.

recipe_fields.required_tags: Knowledge Tags the crafter must possess or partially bridge with skill level.
recipe_fields.materials: Raw and refined components required, including quantities.
recipe_fields.crafting_dc: The difficulty number the crafting roll must meet or exceed.
recipe_fields.required_skills: The Profession Skill(s) governing this recipe.
recipe_fields.time_requirement: In-world time the craft takes to complete.
recipe_fields.functional_material: The material used to calculate item stats (Hardness, Ductility, Density).
recipe_fields.critical_success_effect: Bonus applied when the roll exceeds DC by 10 or more.
recipe_fields.optional_upgrades: Additions that modify weight, DC, or enhance item stats.

outcome_table.critical_success: Roll exceeds DC by 10+. Theoretical recipe or formula works exactly as intended.
outcome_table.success: Roll meets DC. Output functions. Minor unintended properties possible on theoretical crafts.
outcome_table.partial_failure: Roll within 3 of DC. Item or formula fails but reveals information about why.
outcome_table.failure: Roll fails. Materials partially lost (physical) or mana partially returned (magical). Something is learned.
outcome_table.critical_failure: Output appears functional but behaves dangerously or unexpectedly when used. Crafter cannot know until tested.

pattern_writing.description: Encoding a construction into reproducible form. Gated by Profession Skill level.
pattern_writing.level_1: Cannot write patterns. May salvage basic components only.
pattern_writing.level_2: May write patterns for Common-tier items.
pattern_writing.level_3: May write patterns for Uncommon and Rare-tier items.
pattern_writing.level_4: May write patterns for Epic-tier items.
pattern_writing.level_5: May write patterns for Legendary-tier items.

village_craftsperson.name: Village Craftsperson
village_craftsperson.offers: T1-T2 tags and recipes. Basic materials.
village_craftsperson.notes: The entry point. Limited stock but reliable.

guild_trainer.name: Guild Trainer
guild_trainer.offers: T2-T3 tags and recipes. Demonstration crafts.
guild_trainer.notes: Consistent breadth expansion. Materials cost extra.

rapport_gated_specialist.name: Rapport-Gated Specialist
rapport_gated_specialist.offers: T3 tags. Techniques unavailable elsewhere in region.
rapport_gated_specialist.notes: Higher Rapport unlocks higher tier offerings.

recipe_vendor.name: Recipe Vendor
recipe_vendor.notes: Tags must be gained through successful crafting from the recipe.

grandmaster.name: Grandmaster
grandmaster.access: High Rapport required. May require quest.
grandmaster.offers: T4-T5 tags. Unique techniques. Commission work.
grandmaster.notes: Teaching method is personal. Some teach only through proximity to their work.
